extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral cancer researchers applying for the Damon Runyon Fellowship
extracted.subtask_description: Selection criteria and programmatic constraints for the Damon Runyon Cancer Research Foundation postdoctoral fellowship, describing how proposals, applicants, sponsors, and host environments will be evaluated. Intended to guide applicants preparing fellowship applications and sponsors preparing to host fellows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Importance of the problem
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is one element of 'Quality of the Research Proposal' — reviewers assess whether the project addresses an important problem in cancer research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Originality of approach
rubrics_metrics.description: How novel is the experimental strategy?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates novelty of concepts and whether the approach represents a meaningful departure from existing work; part of the 'Quality of the Research Proposal.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriateness of techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Are the methods well-matched to the questions?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether proposed techniques are suitable and sufficient to answer the stated research questions; included under 'Quality of the Research Proposal.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity of presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Is the proposal well-written and accessible?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should be clearly presented so reviewers can evaluate significance, approach, and feasibility; part of 'Quality of the Research Proposal.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Candidate qualifications, experience, and capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Of the candidate — academic record, publications, capability
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers consider the applicant's prior training, accomplishments, and demonstrated ability to carry out the proposed work; evaluated relative to career stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor (host PI) qualifications and mentorship record
rubrics_metrics.description: Of the sponsor — reputation, prior mentorship outcomes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess the host PI's ability to mentor and support the candidate, including track record of trainee outcomes and suitability of the sponsor to enable the fellow's success.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of recommendation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference letters are explicitly considered as part of evaluating candidate and sponsor qualifications; can corroborate productivity, independence, and mentoring quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Productivity relative to career stage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluates publications and accomplishments in the context of the applicant's stage (e.g., early postdoc vs. later); used to judge trajectory and readiness for independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Host laboratory resources and infrastructure
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reviewers examine whether the host lab provides the technical, personnel, and infrastructure support necessary for the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Departmental and institutional environment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assesses the broader institutional context (department, collaborations, facilities) and whether it will foster the candidate's research and career development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential for broadening the candidate's ability to conduct independent innovative research
rubrics_metrics.description: Potential for broadening the candidate's ability to independently conduct innovative research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A key element of the training environment criterion — reviewers value opportunities that expand the applicant's skills, independence, and capacity to do innovative work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-development opportunities at the host site
rubrics_metrics.description: Career-development opportunities at the host site
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment of formal and informal opportunities (training, workshops, networking) that will support the candidate's transition to independence.

rubrics_metrics.name: No direct extension of graduate work (Distinctive programmatic constraint)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Direct extensions of the candidate's graduate work (in approach, technique or exact area of study) will not be funded."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This anti-criterion penalizes continuity with PhD work: applicants must demonstrate movement to a new area, technique, or approach. Program explicitly pre-commits to selecting candidates making intellectual transitions (distinct from most agencies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to excellence and diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI)
rubrics_metrics.description: Uncompromising commitment to excellence AND values diversity, equity, inclusion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Foundation seeks to promote gender equality and increase diversity in all forms throughout programs; DEI is explicitly stated alongside excellence as a program value and consideration.
